install.title: Add Tonus to your Home Screen
install.body: Tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from the icon. Your data is kept more reliably that way.

profiles.name: Name

settings.sound.hint: Soft sounds on taps. The iPhone silent switch mutes them.
app.name: Tonus
home.over: Over the plan in group {letters}. Tomorrow — no guilt, just the plan.
drinks.cups.hint: up to 4 cups, in the first half of the day
drinks.cups.late: after lunch — herbal tea is better
ration.rawHint: Amounts are raw weight. Weighed it cooked? Pick boiled, baked or fried — we’ll convert.
ration.choose: Pick a food. You can mix — they share one group budget.
ration.allDone: All 8 groups covered. Today’s ration is done!
log.nothingLeft: This group is full for today
log.over: That’s {n} {unit} over the plan. Better to log it honestly — and get back to the plan tomorrow.
oil.title: Fried in oil?
oil.body: Oil counts in group “г”. Add what went into the pan.
rules.title: Ration rules
rules.raw: Weights are raw. Weigh food raw; if you weighed it cooked, pick the cooking method.
rules.limit: The key rule: don’t exceed the amounts and eat only foods from the plan.
rules.swap: Swap meals freely and eat 2–6 times a day — whatever suits you.
rules.liquid: Soups and stews: count the ingredients, not the dish.
rules.drinks: Coffee and tea — up to 4 cups, in the first half of the day; herbal tea any time. Use zero-calorie sweeteners.
rules.water: Water as you like, still or sparkling. No juice or sweet drinks. Hungry? Try a sip of water first.
rules.soda: Zero-calorie soda — up to 330 ml a day. Soy sauce, spices and a little salt are fine.
rules.last: Last meal at least an hour before sleep; before a workout — about 2 hours.
rules.weigh: Weigh everything for the first two weeks; after that, by eye is fine.
steps.hint: Take the number from the Health app on iPhone.
measures.due: Once a week — weight, tape and a photo in the same conditions.
measures.emptyHint: Start with weight — the rest is optional. Best in the morning, before eating.
measures.photoHint: Photos stay on your phone and in your private repository.
plan.hint: The amount (100%) is raw weight. Food type decides how cooked weight converts to raw.
plan.resetConfirm: Replace your plan with the coach’s original plan?
plan.importError: This file doesn’t look like a plan.
settings.title: Settings
ideas.title: What to cook with what’s left
ideas.hint: What’s left is split over {n} meals — amounts are for one.
ideas.hint.last: Last meal — these use up everything that’s left.
ideas.sheetHint: Adjust the amounts if needed — then log everything at once.
ideas.home: What to cook with what’s left
dishes.title: Dish ideas
dishes.hint: Ideas size every dish to what you have left. Switch off what you don’t cook, or add your own.
dishes.name: Name
dishes.partsHint: Pick foods from the groups. The first group you pick is the dish’s base; if nothing is left there, the dish isn’t suggested. Several foods in a group are fallbacks, in order.
account.hint: Your data stays on this phone and syncs to your account. No password: you sign in with a code from an email.

account.code: Code or link from the email
account.linkHint: Enter the code from the email, or paste its link (long-press the link → Copy). If the app is open in a browser, you can just tap the link.
account.signOut.hint: Your data stays on this phone. To keep going, you’ll need to sign in again.
welcome.title: Welcome to Tonus
welcome.hint: Create an account or sign in — your data is saved and synced between devices. No password: a code comes by email.

name.hint: It shows in the list of users. You can change it later in Settings.
account.expired: This code or link is used or expired. Each new email cancels the earlier ones — tap “Different email”, send it again and use only the newest one.
